cohort: Primiparous women aged 15-44 years with singleton pregnancies birthing in New South Wales, Australia from 2003 to 2015
finding: Primiparous women with a history of pre-pregnancy stroke were more likely to have an early-term delivery and a pre-labor cesarean, but there were no significant differences in other maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to women without a history of stroke.
mod_finding: Women with a history of pre-pregnancy stroke were more likely to have a pre-labour caesarean.
